operator-404.fixIn: .grok-bot/visual/sweep.spec.ts: operator pages under the installationAdmin scenario (done)

wide-table.title: Wide tables: last column under the edge fade
wide-table.why: Decided on 2026-11-25: a wide table scrolls sideways under its edge shade.

section-header-phone.title: Section description beside its button on phones
section-header-phone.why: On phones a section's description keeps a narrow column beside its Edit button and wraps to three lines, with the space under the button empty. A design-system layout choice; not looked at in detail.

glossary-misread.title: Grok: 'Findings', 'des Workspaces' break the glossary
glossary-misread.why: German keeps Finding and Workspace as nouns with normal plural and genitive (die Findings, des Workspaces); 'Casos' is the page's name.

terms-misread.title: Grok: technical terms must stay English
terms-misread.why: review-notes.md says the English terms ('Standing terms', 'Seed record') are intended; Grok reads that as 'do not translate them'. Clarifying that note stops these.

compound-hyphens.title: Grok: 'AI-SOC-Größe' breaks the glossary
compound-hyphens.why: German compounds with a multi-word name take hyphens (AI-SOC-Größe, Secret-Manager): correct spelling, not a glossary breach.

es-acronym-plural.title: Grok: 'CPU', 'AI SOC' need a plural s in Spanish
es-acronym-plural.why: Spanish leaves acronyms unchanged in the plural (las CPU, los AI SOC).

audit-style.title: Grok: the short audit/activity style is incomplete
audit-style.why: Audit and activity labels use a participle without subject throughout ('Workspace {{name}} angelegt'). Grok's versions break that; some are ungrammatical ('Hat einer Bestätigung … zugestimmt').

lowercase-fragments.title: Grok: fragments start lowercase
lowercase-fragments.why: The English source is lowercase too: these are fragments inside a line ('revoked {{at}}', 'reports not available yet').

term-inconsistent.title: One concept, several words
term-inconsistent.why: Seed record: 'Ausgangsdatensatz', 'Auslösender Datensatz', 'Startdatensatz'; seat: 'Kontositz' and 'Arbeitsplatz' (es 'asiento', 'puesto'); also Produktadministration/-administrator (7×/7×), Dienstzugang/Dienstkonto, Rücknahme/Zurückziehen, Standards/Vorgaben, es periodo/período (20×/18×) and portal de cuenta/cuentas. Grok's reasons are often wrong, the inconsistencies are real.

glossary-breach.title: Finding and Workspace translated against the glossary
glossary-breach.why: 'Funde', 'Befund' and 'Arbeitsbereich' where the glossary says Finding and Workspace.

reihenfolge.title: 'in Reihenfolge' is not idiomatic
reihenfolge.why: 'manipulationssicher und in Reihenfolge', 'nicht in Reihenfolge': German says 'in fester Reihenfolge' / 'nicht in der richtigen Reihenfolge'.

erklaeren.title: 'Quellen erklären' reads as 'explain sources'
erklaeren.why: For declaring sources absent, 'Fehlende Quellen erklären' reads as 'explain missing sources'. 'Quellen als fehlend erklären' says it.

gender-style.title: Paired or participle forms for people
gender-style.why: Decided on 2026-11-25: paired forms for people are the house style.

sample-source-name.title: A source named in English in the sample data
